thread:
ashley_oncall: INCIDENT: page — auth-proxy showing sustained outbound connections to unfamiliar hosts, starting ~01:02 UTC. Spiking to 8-12 rps from the proxy pool. Paging sec/infra.
incident-bot: Pager: @ashley_oncall (oncall) — alert triggered: auth-proxy outbound-anomaly (sev2). Links: https://monitoring.local/alerts/AX12
rahul_sec: I'm on. Can you confirm which env and which cluster?
mike_sre: this is prod-eu cluster A (auth-proxy autoscale group). Just pulled a quick netflow sample: dstIPs: 45.77.22.13, suspicious-1.example, then 198.51.100.9. Ports 443/5222.
ashley_oncall: Confirmed prod-eu. Not seeing obvious CPU/mem spike. Latency to external services up ~30ms.
rahul_sec: checklist start: 1) isolate suspicious egress, 2) capture auth-proxy stdout/stderr + KV cache logs, 3) check recent deploys, 4) rotate any exposed credentials.
claire_cs: any customer-facing impact yet? Any auth failures?
mike_sre: Auth failures are within baseline. Some sessions show TTL refreshs failing intermittently for a subset of users hitting proxied hosts. No wide customer outage.
ashley_oncall: Good. Prioritize containment. rahul, mike — can you block egress to the 2 IPs at the cluster NAT layer?
rahul_sec: Applying temporary deny at NAT gateway now. Command:```aws ec2 revoke-security-group-ingress --group-id sg-xxxx --protocol tcp --port 443 --cidr 45.77.22.13/32``` Doing it via firewall rules (pushed).
mike_sre: Confirmed at 01:08 UTC egress to 45.77.22.13 dropped. 198.51.100.9 still being blocked, in progress.
ops-bot: egress rule update: fw-rule-325 applied to vpc-prod-eu at 2026-03-15T01:08:42Z
rahul_sec: Collecting logs for the window 01:00-01:12. Pulling proxy debug logs. Also seeing a few requests with header `X-Debug-Token: stg-override` which is odd.
ashley_oncall: Who pushed last config to auth-proxy? Any canary deploys?
mike_sre: Last deploy was rolling 5 hours ago, config change by @todd_pm for metric labels only. No new code.
todd_pm: I didn't touch any auth logic or tokens. Only prometheus labels.
rahul_sec: Good. Might be a compromised service key appearing in logs. Search for 'Authorization: Bearer' patterns where token prefixes look similar.
rahul_sec: found pattern in logs: `Authorization: Bearer svc-qa-abc123` from proxy instance ip 10.12.8.33. That token belongs to a staging service account — why is staging token in prod proxy?
mike_sre: That instance was recently reprovisioned from golden image. I'm checking image bootstrap scripts.
ashley_oncall: Possible cause: incorrect secret injection at instance bootstrap. Treat as credential exposure. We'll rotate affected service accounts and any leaked tokens.
rahul_sec: Action items (short): 1) rotate svc tokens seen in logs (rahul), 2) revoke any IAM keys for staging service accounts that have prod network access (mike), 3) verify S3 artifacts and logs not exfiltrated (ashley), 4) notify legal and CS for potential customer notice (nancy, claire).
rahul_sec: Rotating token for svc-qa-abc123 now. New token generated: (omitted). Pushing rotation via secrets manager and triggering sync to services.
ashley_oncall: While rotating, enable session invalidation for the few sessions that used that token. Command to invalidate sessions:```curl -X POST -H "Authorization: Bearer admin-token" https://auth-internal.local/sessions/invalidate -d '{"reason":"suspected token leak","filter":{"service":"svc-qa"}}'```
mike_sre: Revoking IAM keys for staging account and removing any cross-account role that allowed egress. Commands run:```aws iam delete-access-key --user-name staging-svc --access-key-id AKIA...``` Confirmed deleted at 01:16 UTC.
rahul_sec: S3 check: looking for large GET/HEAD patterns from unknown IPs. Preliminary: no bulk reads in bucket: s3://redwood-logs-prod/auth-proxy-debug/ between 00:50-01:30. One object with debug dump `debug-2026-03-15T01-05-00.log` exists and shows the token header. Need to snapshot and lock.
ashley_oncall: Lock that object, change bucket policy to deny public and enforce MFA delete for debug dumps, move to quarantine bucket.
ops-bot: S3 object copied to s3://redwood-security-quarantine/debug-2156007890-log.txt at 2026-03-15T01:20:03Z
nancy_legal: Looping in legal. We'll need to know if any PII or customer tokens were exposed. Keep me posted with findings.
claire_cs: Heads up: prepping a short internal CS note. No customer-facing notice yet until we know token scope.
rahul_sec: Quick forensics: the staging token was used in three requests that initiated outbound connections to suspicious-1.example. Originating host had the staging token injected via a cron that pulls /opt/secrets/staging.env — investigating the CI image build.
mike_sre: Found build script in image pipeline referencing an old secrets S3 path accidentally set to prod. Pushing a fix now to the pipeline to stop including staging secret files in prod images.
ashley_oncall: Good. Next: rotate all tokens that could cross-contaminate and rotate any service account keys with production permissions. Also rotate the KMS envelope key used to encrypt debug artifacts as precaution. rahul, mike please coordinate and post rotation commands.
rahul_sec: Rotation completed for 3 service tokens and 2 IAM access keys. Commands executed and new secrets propagated to vault. Documented in incident timeline.
ashley_oncall: Triage summary for timeline and customer impact: - exposure: single staging token found in prod auth-proxy logs - impact: limited; no large-scale exfiltration detected; no PII seen so far - mitigation: egress blocked, tokens rotated, S3 artifacts quarantined, build pipeline fix pushed - next: full post-incident review, runbook update, notify any affected customers if evidence changes.
todd_pm: Can we get an ETA for full RCA doc and remediation backlog?
rahul_sec: RCA draft by EOD UTC. Will include root cause (image build secret path), timeline, blast radius, and recommended mitigations (strict image isolation, pre-deploy secret audits, automated egress anomaly blocking).
ashley_oncall: Handoff: I'm ending this shift. @mike_sre you're next on-call lead for ongoing follow-ups. Please continue monitoring for any re-appearance and coordinate with legal/CS on notices.
mike_sre: Acknowledged — taking over. Monitoring rules tightened.’ll run 15m cadence checks for next 4 hours.
ashley_oncall: Thanks everyone. Filing incident ticket INC-2156007890 and assigning to sec/infra for RCA. :white_check_mark:
incident-bot: Incident INC-2156007890 created, sev2, owner: sec-team, runbook: https://wiki.redwood/incident-runbooks/auth-egress.
nancy_legal: Keep me in the loop if customer tokens are confirmed.
claire_cs: Will prepare templated customer comms but hold until we confirm blast radius.
ashley_oncall: Signing off. Good job on quick containment.
